entry.title: reader: keep the frequency on the lookup count's line
entry.content:
reader: keep the frequency on the lookup count's line

As an inline box the frequency capsule still dropped to its own row
whenever its full width did not fit beside the count. The count and the
capsule now share a flex row. The capsule starts at zero width and grows
to its natural width, wrapping its own tags, so it leaves the line only
when a single tag cannot fit.

Frequency tags in the capsule keep their full width, so a narrow line
wraps between tags instead of clipping values or dictionary names. The
Freq: label moves into the first tag so a wrap never strands it, and
the pill's radius is 13px: unchanged on one line, a rounded box when
wrapped.

entry.title: popup: show only the English gloss of Sanseido senses in compact defi…
entry.content:
popup: show only the English gloss of Sanseido senses in compact definitions

Sanseido-style dictionaries (sankoku en-jp, 三省堂国語辞典, 新明解国語辞典)
mark sections with data.name, which the compact summary did not recognise.
It fell back to leaf blocks, usually the example sentences, and picked up
sense numbers, labels, furigana and the Japanese half of bilingual glosses.

The glossary-marker discovery pass now also finds 語義 senses. Each sense
contributes only its 語釈 gloss (including 副義 sub-senses), and a bilingual
gloss keeps the English text before the bare space that opens the Japanese.
ルビG furigana is left out like rt. Senses holding only a ⇨ reference and
index entries that are bare sub-headword links contribute nothing, so the
summary moves on as it does for Jitendex redirects.

entry.title: Put the primary frequency beside the lookup count (#171)
entry.content:
Put the primary frequency beside the lookup count (#171)

* test: expect the primary frequency beside the lookup count

The popup stacks "Looked up N times" and the Freq pill on separate rows,
which wastes a line above the definitions. Check they share a row when
the popup is wide enough.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01MzoimGPnrWLEEpuwQ1TJvw

* reader: put the primary frequency beside the lookup count

The metadata capsule was a block-level flex box, so it always started a
new row under the lookup count. As an inline flex box it sits beside
the count and still wraps below it when the popup is too narrow. Its
bottom margin goes because inline margins no longer collapse into the
definitions below, which keeps the old spacing when it wraps or stands
alone.
